Title: General availability: Azure Stack HCI new feature update

Body.Content:
The new feature update of Azure Stack HCI is now generally available. General availability means that the new features and workloads for Azure Stack HCI are now ready for production use. Starting today, deployments using Azure Stack HCI are eligible for production-level technical support with enhanced capabilities and are billed at the regular non-preview price. The new Azure Stack HCI is the recommended version for all new deployments and is available as an over-the-air update for existing customers. 

Learn more.
